answer: Citation-echo bond: each identity locks 70 credit, cites one contribution, and must echo its result this epoch. A jade seal stamps the citation if the echo matches; the registry publishes a source-and-seal signal. Auditors watch the signal stream: many citing one source mark a rented-citation ring; the cluster is slashed. The kth citation on one source pays 45+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45 once.
